description: Uploads, edits, moves and deletes the media of an app, and manages its collections. More: neblla_get_llms tools/media

action.description: By action: shrink {ids | collection, maxSide?, dryRun?}; update {id, title?, text?, alt?, note?, fields?, replaceFields?}; move {ids, collection, position?}; reorder {collection, ids}; delete {ids}; create_collection {collection}; rename_collection {collection, newName}; delete_collection {collection, withItems?}; private {ids |…

collection.description: The collection, by its name ("Bodas") or key ("bodas")

dryRun.description: For shrink: say what it would save, change nothing

fields.description: For update: merged into the card; null removes a field

id.description: For get, update, holders and download_link

ids.description: For move, reorder, delete, shrink, private, link and unlink

maxSide.description: For shrink: the long side to reduce to, in px

note.description: For update: the note for the developer's AI

position.description: For upload and move: at the end

private.description: For private (required) and upload: the original is private

productId.description: For link and unlink: a one_time product or a subscription

publicWidth.description: For private and upload: the widest variant the public sees of a private image

replaceFields.description: For update: the fields given replace all of them

resize.description: For upload: true reduces the images bigger than a screen needs

withItems.description: For delete_collection: delete its items too

name: neblla_media
title: Media
